verdict.rationale: Morph is an inference and tooling API (Fast Apply, WarpGrep, Compact, Reflexes, dedicated endpoints). The evidence never documents a way for users to define or schedule automations that run on their own in the background. The 'standby' service tier is only a discounted, deprioritized request class for batch or background traffic the user sends themselves. The Kimi K3 canary is a traffic-splitting migration aid. Neither is a background automation capability, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
